pull_requests.title: feat(server): send security headers with every response
pull_requests.body: serve.py now sends Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy on every response, error pages included. The policy keeps the page to its own origin, so it only loads scripts, styles and images from its own files and no other site can frame it. Steepwell already loads everything from public/, so the timer works exactly as before.

pull_requests.title: feat(page): add a dark theme toggle that remembers the choice
pull_requests.body: A Dark theme button in the header switches Steepwell between its light and dark palettes. The choice is saved in localStorage, so the page opens in the same theme next time, and the theme script runs in the page head so a saved dark theme applies before the first paint, with no flash of the light page.
